generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing work
List of works for which tenders already submitted
As per Government Order NO: FD 884 EXP-12/2019 Dated: 07-05-2020 action will be taken if the documents submitted by the tenderer found to be misleading /forged or fake.
ALL TERMS AND CONDITIONS AS PER KW-1 TENDER DOC,GST Will be piad separately as per Govt Order, REFER TENDER SCHEDULES (DATES) IN E PORTAL
The bidder has to quote exclusive of GST

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Valid Class 2 and above Electrical contract license issued by electrical inspectorate

Annual Turnover Certificate of financial year i.e., 2021-22 to 2025-26 achieved in at least Two financial years a minimum financial turnover of Rs 13.85 Lakh and Turnover certificate from CA with valid UDIN Number is mandatory

Satisfactorily completed as a prime contractor at least one similar work as building wiring/ Building Electrification/maintenance in any one year in the Last Five Financial Year i.e., 2021-22 to 2025-26 for Value not less than Rs. 6.93Lakhs Work Done certificate should be issued by not less than the Rank of Executive Engineer along with the mention of E procurement Indent Number
